equity.level_reason: Incidence by race/ethnicity (within birth origin) is reported, ranked and framed as an ongoing disparity, but this report computes no between-group difference or ratio (only within-group year-to-year % change); the 10-fold contrast is cited from an earlier report, so the side-by-side cap applies.

level_alternative.reason: Disparity explicitly framed and interpreted for AI/AN and NH/OPI persons with incidence values reported (e.g., 6.6 vs 0.3); a reader treating the ranked rates as quantified would give 3.

ev.q: Higher TB incidence among AI/AN and NH/OPI persons represents an ongoing health disparity ( 2 ) in the United States.

equity.equity_measurement: Race-specific incidence uses Current Population Survey denominators and is reported only within birth-origin strata; multiple race and unknown race are combined with no rate; no referent group or ratio is computed.
